description: Use for the Score on one day: its value (0–100), its classification (Low, Moderate-low, Neutral, Elevated or High) and whether the day is live or backtested (daily since July 18, 2011, backtested with the current method before live publication). Choose it for a single day; for today's Score with its historical position and the five market areas use get_score_live, for a run of days get_score_history, for recent change get_score_momentum. Free through the Delayed date (the free cut-off, three months before the latest published day). A later day, or live = true, costs $0.25 in bitcoin over Lightning, one payment per answer, no subscription: the first call returns an invoice instead of data (steps under payment).

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, from 2011-07-18. Default: the Delayed date (free), or the latest published day with live = true. A day after the Delayed date is paid ($0.25).

live.description: true: data through the latest published day, paid ($0.25). Omit or false: the free answer, through the Delayed date.

payment.description: Omit on the first call: a paid request then returns a Lightning invoice (valid 10 minutes) and a macaroon instead of data. Pay it, then repeat the call with the same other arguments and payment = "<macaroon>:<preimage>" (the preimage your wallet shows once paid) within 24 hours. A used, expired or mismatched proof is refused with the reason; call again without payment for a new invoice.

name: get_score_for_day

as_of.description: UTC: the last day the answer covers (YYYY-MM-DD), or for the Brief and methodology the time it was published (ISO 8601)

delayed_through.description: The Delayed date: free answers stop here

title: BTC Intel Score for a day
